purpose: Separate course-use semantic validation from historical recovery and from language-authority promotion.

decisions_requested.statement: Accept AUTH-001 KUVAN as the governed v1.1 locative interrogative variable for Lesson 1 course use.
Accept EN ... KE as the governed v1.1 beginner question frame for these two locative cards: EN as second-person referent and KE as clause-final interrogative operator.
Accept bare [PLACE] as a sufficient beginner answer pattern for these location questions, without adding an unrecovered copula, preposition or case marker.

OPI005.core: VALI = work, FROZEN; L01 use via governed curriculum rebind with no semantic change

explicit_non_effects: Does not mark KUVAN as recovered historical HNK.
Does not promote KUVAN from CANDIDATE to FROZEN.
Does not declare EN or KE universal HNK grammar outside the approved course scope.
Does not recover the missing v1.0 raw payload.
Does not freeze either OPI; FROZEN remains a later publication gate.
application_rule: Do not apply projected VALIDATED transitions unless explicit human approval is recorded for this exact batch or equivalent scoped decisions.
